cohort: Approximately 90,000 pregnant women infected with COVID-19 between September 1, 2021 and January 30, 2022
finding: Maternal COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy was associated with a lower risk of hospitalization, ICU admission, cesarean section, and stillbirth in women infected with COVID-19.
mod_finding: COVID-19 vaccination was associated with a lower rate of cesarean section.
